reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Salt loading is a real strategy for hot marathons, but the right amount depends on your sweat rate, sodium losses, and any medical conditions, and it can go wrong if you overdo it. Holt doesn't dose electrolytes. Ask a doctor or sports dietitian to help you set your plan, and practice it in your long runs so you know how your gut and body respond before race day. Once you've got your plan, tell me your race date and I'll build your program around it."}
